name: Embracing Evil lengthens Bane duration and cuts its Energy cost (#1331)
contract: Embracing Evil increases the duration of Banes such as Bane of Chaos (704368) by 20% and reduces their Energy cost by 20%, via native SPELLMOD_DURATION (op1) and SPELLMOD_COST (op14) percent SpellMods matching the Banes' family20 classMask1 bit5 flag. The DBC stores EffectBasePoints 19 and -21 with DieSides 1, so SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue resolves them to 20 and -20 (basePoints+1), one point off the tooltip's 19%/21%. A third effect on a different classmask bit does not match the tooltipped Felfury refund and is a separate, unreported quirk not covered here.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Base Bane of Chaos duration is unaffected
Embracing Evil lengthens Bane of Chaos duration by 20% (EffectBasePoints 19 + 1, DieSides 1)
Base Bane of Chaos cost is unaffected
Embracing Evil cuts Bane of Chaos cost by 20% (EffectBasePoints -21 + 1, DieSides 1)
